method: One fresh worker per case; AB then BA order, identical input seed and content; each run regenerates arrays and checks its own outputs. Warmup and native MACA event timing scope unchanged. 14 timed per-call averages per version (2 passes x 7 rounds; each round averages 2 native calls).

from pathlib import Path
import argparse,ctypes,hashlib,importlib.util,json,statistics,subprocess,sys,datetime
ROOT=Path('/root/MOE/C500_int8_02All')
BASE=Path('/tmp/moe_register_baseline_2026_10_20/02_optimized_gemm')
SHAPES=ROOT/'benchmarks/baseline_shapes_2026-10-16.json'
OUTPUT=ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/reports/register_comparison_2026-10-20.json'
SOURCES={'vector':BASE/'optimized_gemm.cpp','register':ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/optimized_gemm.cpp'}
LIBRARIES={'vector':BASE/'libmoe_int8_shared.so','register':ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/libmoe_int8_shared.so'}
SETTINGS=dict(warmup=3,iterations=2,rounds=7,check_samples=256,seed=20261016)
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def signatures():return {v:dict(source=str(SOURCES[v]),source_sha256=digest(SOURCES[v]),library=str(LIBRARIES[v]),library_sha256=digest(LIBRARIES[v])) for v in SOURCES}
def worker(index):
 import torch
 torch.cuda.set_device(0)
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench',ROOT/'benchmarks/bench_shapes.py')
 bench=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(bench)

 args=argparse.Namespace(**SETTINGS)
 libs={};functions={}
 for version,p in LIBRARIES.items():
  libs[version]=ctypes.CDLL(str(p));fn=libs[version].moe_int8_benchmark
  fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*6+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.c_void_p]+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)];fn.restype=ctypes.c_int;functions[version]=fn
 record=dict(case=case,versions=signatures(),torch_version=torch.__version__,device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),visible_memory_bytes=torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory,mx_smi=bench.command_output(['mx-smi']),runs=[])
 for repeat,order in enumerate([['vector','register'],['register','vector']]):
  for version in order:
   result=bench.run_case(case,functions[version],args)
   import math
   tile=16 if version=='vector' else 32
   bound=case['capacity'] if case['layout']=='masked' else min(sum(case['counts']),65536)
   launched=math.ceil(case['n']/tile)*math.ceil(bound/tile)*len(case['counts'])
   useful=math.ceil(case['n']/tile)*sum(math.ceil(m/tile) for m in case['counts'])
   result.update(block_m=tile,block_n=tile,launched_blocks=launched,useful_blocks=useful,useful_block_fraction=useful/launched if launched else 0)
   record['runs'].append(dict(repeat=repeat,version=version,result=result))
   assert result['status']=='PASS',result
   print(index,repeat,version,case['name'],result['median_ms'],'PASS',flush=True)
   torch.cuda.empty_cache()
 summary={}
 for version in SOURCES:
  runs=[x['result'] for x in record['runs'] if x['version']==version]
  samples=[t for x in runs for t in x['samples_ms']]
  summary[version]=dict(median_ms=statistics.median(samples),min_ms=min(samples),max_ms=max(samples),samples_ms=samples,checked_elements=sum(x['checked_elements'] for x in runs),padding_checked=sum(x['padding_checked'] for x in runs))
 record['summary']=summary;record['speedup']=summary['vector']['median_ms']/summary['register']['median_ms'];record['status']='PASS'
 Path(f'/tmp/moe_register_pair_{index}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
def main():
 if len(sys.argv)>1:
  worker(int(sys.argv[1]));return
 initial=signatures()
 report=dict(timestamp_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),baseline_commit='8621c29b3324d13ed0aba3ae1267b6effb6b059e',scope='INT8x4 baseline versus 2x2 per-thread register tiling; C500 16GB / 25% sGPU; not full fused MoE',method='One fresh worker per case; AB then BA order, identical input seed and content; each run regenerates arrays and checks its own outputs. Warmup and native MACA event timing scope unchanged. 14 timed per-call averages per version (2 passes x 7 rounds; each round averages 2 native calls).',settings=SETTINGS,versions=initial,harness_sha256=digest(ROOT/'benchmarks/bench_shapes.py'),paired_driver_sha256=digest(Path(__file__)),shapes_sha256=hashlib.sha256(SHAPES.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest(),reproduction_script=Path(__file__).read_text(),grid_metrics_note='Public harness assumes 16x16 tiles; this driver corrects reporting-only grid metrics to 16 for vector baseline and 32 for register tiling. Numerical checks and native timing are unchanged.',results=[])
 cases=json.loads(SHAPES.read_text())
 for i,case in enumerate(cases):
  print('PAIRED_CASE',i+1,len(cases),case['name'],flush=True)
  output=Path(f'/tmp/moe_register_pair_{i}.json')
  if output.exists():output.unlink()
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(Path(__file__).resolve()),str(i)])
  assert p.returncode==0 and output.exists(),(i,p.returncode)
  item=json.loads(output.read_text());assert item['versions']==initial and item['case']==case
  report['results'].append(item)
  OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
 assert signatures()==initial
 report['status']='PASS';OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
 print('PAIRED_ALL_PASS',len(cases),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
